name: cdmx-security
description: Security tooling for Claude Code. Runs real scanners and verifies every finding against source.

plugins.name: security-audit
plugins.description: Runs real security scanners (Semgrep, gitleaks, TruffleHog, Trivy, osv-scanner, ZAP) over code, full git history, dependencies, IaC and Supabase/Firebase row-level security, then verifies every finding against source before reporting. Produces one severity-ranked report tagged to OWASP Top 10 2025.
